info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Channel Specific Card Terminal Administrations-spec
info.description: The Channel-Specific Card Terminal Administrations API allows businesses to access detailed information about the administration of card terminals within specific channels. This endpoint provides vital insights into card terminal configurations, usage statistics, and management functionalities. Typical consumers include banking and financial institutions seeking to analyze and manage card terminal operations efficiently. This API supports data-driven decision-making and enhances the overall management of terminal resources.

get.summary: Retrieve card terminal administration details for a specific channel.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the administration information related to card terminals for a specific channel. By using this endpoint, developers can retrieve relevant details necessary for managing and configuring card terminals effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the card terminal administration details for a specific channel. It should contain all necessary parameters to specify the required data.

200.description: Request completed successfully; returns the current state of card terminal administration.

ListChannelSpecificCardTerminalAdministr.description: Represents a request body for the GET operation on card terminal administration specific to a specific channel.
